description:
1. Capture the current value of var and record it along with any available type information into a file named 'var_snapshot.txt'.
2. Produce a cleaned, normalized textual form of that recorded value by removing surrounding whitespace and quotes, save it as 'var_normalized.txt', and record in 'var_meta.txt' whether the normalized form appears to represent a whole number (digits with an optional leading sign).
3. Combine 'var_normalized.txt' and 'var_meta.txt' into 'var_check_ready.txt' with a concise summary of the evidence and readiness criteria needed to decide if var is an integer, without making the final decision.

Test if variable var is an integer? If so, tell me "yes", otherwise tell me "no". (Without quotes)
